name: Induced land use change (ILUC) of canola biodiesel
notes:
ILUC (induced land use change)

-----2024
R&D GREET 2024 includes the indirect emissions from Canola Biodiesel Pathway, which were estimated using AEZ-EF for both domestic and international regions

-----2018
Domestic CO2 emissions from ILUC: 68 g/gal of biodiesel
Foreign CO2 emissions from ILUC: 1103 g/gal of biodiesel

1. Palm-on-peat factor (% of new palm on peat forest in SE Asia) = 22
2. Emissions related to peat loss (t CO2e ha-1 yr-1) = 55
3. Instead of "conventional till", "US Average" till set as baseline or reference tillage

---- 2017
Domestic CO2 emissions from ILUC: 90 g/gal of biodiesel
Foreign CO2 emissions from ILUC: 868 g/gal of biodiesel

Reference: Chen, Rui, Zhangcai Qin, Jeongwoo Han, Michael Wang, Farzad Taheripour, Wallace Tyner, Don O'Connor, and James Duffield.
